duration.question: Are you paid to take duration?
duration.read: cash (SHV) yields 3.73% at duration 0.35, intermediate (IEF) 3.97% at duration 7.3, long (TLT) 4.73% at duration 16.5; the yield per unit of duration is highest at SHV.
duration.note: Descriptive, not a rate call. The historical evidence that starting yield explains most of a bond sleeve's multi-year return is the basis; a low term-premium percentile means extension is thinly compensated.

credit.question: Are you paid to take credit?
credit.read: IG spreads pick up 80.0bp over duration-matched Treasuries (21.5th percentile, normal); HY 271.0bp (10.1th percentile, tight).
credit.note: The pickup is the option-adjusted spread over duration-matched Treasuries. Credit spreads mean-revert slowly; a tight percentile means little compensation for default and illiquidity risk. Descriptive; no spread-direction prediction.

real_vs_nominal.question: TIPS or nominal Treasuries?
real_vs_nominal.read: At the 10-year maturity, TIPS and nominal Treasuries carry the same real yield when inflation runs at the 2.38% breakeven; TIPS out-carry nominal if realized inflation exceeds 2.38%, nominal out-carry if it runs below. The breakeven sits at its 81.9th percentile over ten years — the inflation compensation priced into nominals is historically high.
real_vs_nominal.note: Descriptive; decides only which carries better at the breakeven, not an inflation forecast.
